dedupe_keys.name: prebuilt electricity network for gb dispatch model pypsa eur soft fork based on openstreetmap data

description: Prebuilt Electricity Network for gb-dispatch-model (PyPSA-Eur soft-fork) based on OpenStreetMap Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Bryn Pickering, Yerbol Akhmetov (Open Energy Transition). This is an updated version of https://zenodo.org/records/14144752 (v0.7) to capture latest changes in openstreetmap. It is a resource for a model focussed on Great Britain and is therefore limited to those European countries that are defined by the NESO FES: Pathways to Net Zero – European Electricity Supply Data Table (ES2): Austria (AT), Belgium (BE) ... Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
